data.title: Weather Picture Log
data.description: Come help us track the daily weather and discover what season is outside your window today.

challenges.instruction: Play the month. Each school day, watch the weather in the tank and see its picture go into the weather log. Then tell me: which season was it? Which weather in the log shows it?
